_comment: Width allowances (px, FONT_NORMAL) for batch ui-a (menus/UI/system strings). Each value verified against the window template / print call cited in the matching _why entry.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_SaveFileCorru: CreateMainMenuErrorWindow prints on window 7 = sWindowTemplates_MainMenu[7] (MENU_WIDTH_ERROR 26 tiles = 208 px, height 4 = 2 lines), FONT_NORMAL at x=0.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_BatteryRunDry: CreateMainMenuErrorWindow, window 7 = 26 tiles = 208 px, x=0, FONT_NORMAL; text has a \p so 8 px are kept for the down arrow.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_MainMenuNewGa: main menu headers: AddTextPrinterParameterized3(n, FONT_NORMAL, x=0, ...) on sWindowTemplates_MainMenu[0..6], all MENU_WIDTH = 26 tiles = 208 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_ContinueMenuP: MainMenu_FormatSavegamePlayer: label at x=0, player name (PLAYER_NAME_LENGTH 7, <= 48 px) right-aligned to x=100 in window 2 -> label must end before ~52 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_ContinueMenuT: MainMenu_FormatSavegameTime: label at x=0x6C=108, play time 'hhh:mm' (<= 36 px) right-aligned to x=0xD0=208 -> label <= 64 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:gText_ContinueMenuB: MainMenu_FormatSavegameBadges: label at x=108, one-digit badge count right-aligned to x=208 -> label <= 92 px.
_why src/main_menu.c:sMalePresetNames,sr: preset player names copied into gSaveBlock2Ptr->playerName (PLAYER_NAME_LENGTH = 7 chars); same 7 x 6 px rule the validator uses for name fields; all names <= 7 chars.
_why src/data/script_menu.h: multichoice lists: DrawMultichoiceMenuInternal / DrawMultichoiceMenuDynamic (script_menu.c) size the window from the widest item: ConvertPixelWidthToTileWidth(w) = (w+9)/8+1 tiles, capped at MAX_MULTICHOICE_WIDTH 28 tiles, and ScriptMenu_AdjustLeftCoordFromWidth shifts the window left to keep it on screen; PrintMenuTable draws at x=8 (cursor). Items up to 207 px fit in the 28-tile cap. Translations were kept much narrower; non-list strings have their own keys below.
_why src/data/script_menu.h:MultichoiceL: MauvilleCity_GameCorner: multichoice 12,0 next to showcoinsbox 0,0; the original list is 18 tiles wide ((132+9)/8+1); 134 px keeps it at 18 tiles so it does not shift left onto the coins box.
MauvilleCity_GameCorner: multichoice 12,0 next to showcoinsbox 0,0; keep the original width (18 tiles).
MULTI_STATUS_INFO is drawn by ScriptMenu_MultichoiceGrid with 3 columns (RustboroCity_PokemonSchool); keep the original cell width.
_why src/data/script_menu.h:sSeagallopDe: DrawSeagallopDestinationMenu (script_menu.c): CreateWindowFromRect(17, top, 11, ...) = 11 tiles = 88 px, text at x = GetMenuCursorDimensionByFont(FONT_NORMAL, 0) = 8 -> 80 px.
_why src/data/script_menu.h:gStdStrings: gStdStrings are copied into STR_VAR_x (bufferstdstring / tv.c); ctextcheck measures every {STR_VAR_n} as 10 chars = 60 px in the containing messages, so 60 px keeps those checks valid.
_why src/data/script_menu.h:gStdStrings/: only used by BattleFrontier_Lounge2_EventScript_BufferMultiLink -> BattleFrontier_Lounge2_Text_BattleTowerIsHottest, line 'la modalità {STR_VAR_1}!' = 55 px + 80 px, far below the 216-px field message box.
_why src/pokemon_storage_system.c:gText_: printed with AddTextPrinterParameterized2(0, FONT_NORMAL, ...) on window 0 = field message box (sStandardTextBox_WindowTemplates, 27 tiles = 216 px, x=0) while the PC main menu is open.
_why src/pokemon_storage_system.c:sMainM: names: CreateMainMenu sets template.width = GetMaxWidthInMenuTable() = ConvertPixelWidthToTileWidth(widest) (<= 28 tiles, left 1), PrintMenuTable at x=8 -> up to 207 px; descriptions: AddTextPrinterParameterized2(0, FONT_NORMAL, desc) on the 27-tile (216 px) field message box, 2 lines.
_why src/pokemon_storage_system.c:gText_: default box name prefix ('Box ' + number) copied into the box name buffer (BOX_NAME_LENGTH 8 chars), same 8 x 6 px rule as user-entered box names.
_why src/pokemon_storage_system.c:sMessa: PrintMessage: AddTextPrinterParameterized(WIN_MESSAGE, FONT_NORMAL, text, x=0, ...); sWindowTemplates[WIN_MESSAGE] width 18 tiles = 144 px, one line.
WIN_MESSAGE 144 px, one line, minus 60 px for the {DYNAMIC 0} Pokemon nickname (10 chars x 6 px, as the validator assumes for name placeholders).
_why src/pokemon_storage_system.c:sMenuT: AddMenu: menuWindow.width = longest StringLength() + 2 tiles, PrintMenuTable at x=8, so every item fits by construction (8 px per character >= glyph widths); tilemapLeft = 29 - width stays >= 0 for items up to 27 chars. 120 px = 15+ characters.
